title: Research Methods and Program Evaluation in Counselling
description: An introduction to quantitative and qualitative research designs, the research process, the selection and design of data collection instruments and methods, writing and reporting findings, and systematically evaluating and critiquing the quality of research studies. An introduction to program evaluation in counselling contexts is also provided.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of CNPY 512, ED-D 561A, ED-D 561.
